name: morphing-text
title: Morphing Text
blurb: Text smoothly morphs between words in a rotating list.
description: Uses SVG path morphing or canvas to blend letters between adjacent words, creating a fluid multi-word transition.
use_when: Storytelling or feature showcase sections with a curated set of 3–5 key terms.
avoid_when: Long lists — morphing scales poorly and is hard to read with many words.
a11y: Only the current morph frame is readable. No pause or transcript.
